item.title: The Graveyard Project
item.description: This Course Begins with Mortuary Archaeology I want you to gain some experience of collecting data, and of how data models (or our expectations of what we’ll find) influence the subsequent work that we can do with the information that we collect. ‘Data’ means things given but the goal (a goal) of this exercise is to see this information more like ‘capta’ or things created/crafted/captured. Archaeology has some well established models for capturing the observations made at the trowel’s edge.
